release_notes:
• Unified Finance Architecture — All payments (expenses, recurring bills, purchase orders, contracts, payroll) now flow through a single ledger that updates the budget automatically
• Payroll Integration — Approved payroll now posts to the budget as a single monthly expense and can be unfinalized if needed
• Recurring Bills — Track monthly utilities (NWSC, UMEME, Waste collection) with due-date reminders and one-click payment recording
• Contract Installments — Pay signed agreements in scheduled installments with automatic expense creation and progress tracking
• Budget Recompute — One-click to resync all budget actuals from Paid expenses
• Purchase Order Auto-Numbering — PO numbers auto-generate in PO-YY-NNN format
• Category & Subcategory Masters — Manage budget categories from a single location with dropdowns everywhere
• Bug Fixes — Fixed PO loading, term resolution, budget sync, and multiple data integrity issues
• AI text polishing on student report teacher comments — improves grammar and spelling while retaining originality
• Footer images on specific PDFs, especially those in assessments
• Please read the manual for a step-by-step guide or ask Centra AI assistant
